subject.title: [Bug]: Windows Scheduled Task gateway restart/health becomes inconsistent after ready

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical Windows Scheduled Task restart/health tracker while maintainers choose the narrow relaunch/listener fix path and live Windows proof requirements?
rationale: Current main fixes some subsets, but the remaining work overlaps multiple open issues and PRs whose scopes are narrower, proof-blocked, or maintainer-owned, so automation should not spawn another repair path without maintainer direction.

options.title: Keep Broad Canonical Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require one coordinated Windows Scheduled Task repair with live relaunch and health proof before closing it.

options.title: Split After Live Repro
options.body: Ask for a current Windows repro and then split any confirmed post-ready HTTP instability into a narrower follow-up while closing this only after the restart pieces land.

options.title: Close After Narrow PRs Merge
options.body: Wait for the narrower open Windows Scheduled Task PRs/issues to merge or close, then re-evaluate whether any broad post-ready symptom remains.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Canonical Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require one coordinated Windows Scheduled Task repair with live relaunch and health proof before closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to vincentkoc and he has recent related Windows restart-health history.
